formal_statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 6 (fun x : Fin 6 → Bool => (x 0 && x 1) || (x 1 && x 2) || (x 0 && x 2) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 3 && x 4) || (x 4 && x 5) || (x 3 && x 5)) 9
plain_statement: On six inputs, take two triangles joined by an edge: edges 0-1, 1-2, 0-2, 2-3, 3-4, 4-5, 3-5. Some circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 9 gates computes the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true.
title: Dumbbell (two triangles joined by an edge): some circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 9 gates computes its edge function
